title: Natural injection obtained from the Roos connecting map

from.place: proof, the corresponding kernel/cokernel half of the five-term sequence

statement: Let $K:\mathbf N^{op}\to D(\mathrm{Ab})$ [def-weil-inverse-system, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be a tower whose product exists. Write $c_i:H^i(\prod K_n)\to\prod H^i(K_n)$ for the comparison induced by the product projections [def-weil-category-product]. For each integer $i$, there is a simultaneous family of maps $a_{K,L,p,\delta}:R^1\lim H^{i-1}(K)\to H^i(L)$ [lem-pc-derived-limit-roos-abelian-groups], defined for all triples $(L,p,\delta)$. If the specified Roos triangle is distinguished [def-weil-derived-limit], $a$ is mono and the complex $R^1\lim H^{i-1}(K)\xrightarrow{a}H^i(L)\xrightarrow{H^i(p)c_i}\prod H^i(K_n)$ has zero composite and is exact at its middle term. For every morphism of specified distinguished Roos triangles $(\varphi,g)$, satisfying the squares for $p$ and $\delta$, the family satisfies $R^1\lim H^{i-1}(\varphi)\,a_{K\prime}=a_K H^i(g)$. No assertion about a map to the inverse limit or its surjectivity is included.

proof.text: Use the Mathlib AB4Star instance for abelian groups and derivedCategory_countableProducts_and_towerLimit to make the cohomology product comparisons isomorphisms. Projectionwise computation (comparison_transition) identifies the image of the transition endomorphism with the Roos map.

For each distinguished Roos triangle, conjugate HomologySequence.exact₃ by the product comparison. Descend the connecting arrow through the Roos cokernel; mono_cokernelDesc proves it mono. Conjugate HomologySequence.exact₁ by the product comparisons, and transport exactness along the cokernel projection (exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono). Compose with the Roos R¹-limit-to-cokernel isomorphism and transport exactness once more.

Define the family explicitly by the inverse product comparison, the homology connecting map, cokernel.desc, and the Roos isomorphism; use zero outside distinguished triangles. A tower morphism gives a triangle morphism by transition naturality. Apply homologySequenceδ_naturality and the Roos isomorphism naturality, then cokernel.map_desc and projectionwise comparison_natural to prove the displayed square.
